t: Debarim haasurim beyom tob lahakanat tzali
s: Debarim haasurim beyom tob lahakanat tzali ubo g' seipim: en melabbenim et hareapim beyom tob kede leepot o litzlot alehem, apillu im i epshar lo leepot velitzlot beinyan acher, mippene sheal yede hallibbun hen mitchassemin (perush mitqashshin umitchazzeqin), vaapillu hen yeshanim, mikkol maqom kol shaa shehen mitlabbenim hen mitchazzeqin yoter, vahare zeh metaqqen keli beyom tob (ayyen simman ttz"h).

Hatztzoleh dagim al gabbe haaskala — hare zeh lo yachtok chatikat neyar kede lishrotah bemayim velittenah tachat haddag al gabbe haaskala kede shello yissarep haddag, veken lo yishbor chatikat cheres kede littenah tachat haddag, veken lo yiptza et haqqaneh litten qerum shello tachat haddag, veken en potzein et haqqaneh laasoto kemin shappud litzlot bo, lepi shekkol shehu oseh umetaqqen dabar harauy lehishtammesh bo — hare zeh kimtaqqen keli beyom tob.
Muttar liptzoa et haegoz bematlit veen chosheshin shemma tiqqara, sheap im tiqqara hare zeh meqalqel upatur min hattora, ella im ken qorea al menat litpor.
